create_sampler_uniform: create a Uniform sampler that generates tensors with values between 0.0 and 1.0
create_sampler_normal: create a Normal sampler that generates tensors with a specified mean and standard deviation
create_sampler_truncated_normal: create a TruncatedNormal sampler that generates tensors bounded by min and max values
test_sampler_uniform: test the Uniform sampler generates tensors with uniform distribution over a given shape
test_sampler_normal: test the Normal sampler generates tensors with normal distribution over a given shape
